title: Fireballs seen over Washington DC in the 1950s

tellings.quote: Those flying kind of uh fireballs that were seen over Washington DC in the 50s that seem to have some credibility.

plain: A former government official named Eric Haseltine, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, mentions flying fireballs that were seen over Washington DC in the 1950s. He says these sightings seem to have some credibility, which would matter because it would mean strange objects were showing up over the US capital itself.
